name: octopad-mcp
description: Optional Octopad skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: manage-product-documentation
plugins.description: Organizes and maintains evidence-based product documentation in Octopad as product work evolves.

plugins.name: octoplan-claude
plugins.description: Turns an Octopad work stream into an execution-ready plan of detailed, ordered, self-contained tasks, agrees a delivery contract with you, and then supervises the delivery of that plan once you give an explicit go. Works for engineering and non-technical work alike. This is the Claude Code distribution of Octoplan; Codex runs its own. Requires a connected Octopad MCP server.

plugins.name: meeting-to-octopad
plugins.description: Turns a meeting transcript into validated Octopad changes: decisions, action items, progress updates, open questions, and goal signals, each backed by a verbatim quote, matched against the tasks, pages, work streams, and goals you already have, and proposed in one table that you approve before anything is written. Requires a connected Octopad MCP server.
